full_judgment: 2. Facts of the case, in brief, are that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 264 of 1995 in the Court of Assistant Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka for declaration of title over the suit property stating, inter alia, that CS Plot No. 241 comprising 12.17 acres of land belonged to Udai Bepari. During last CS operation his name appeared in the column of owner and the name of his 6 sons and daughters appeared in the column of possessor. In the remark column possession of each son and daughters were displayed showing Nani one of the son of Udai as in possession of suit plot No. 352 and 392 under CS Khatian No. 341 comprising 1.28 acres of land of the suit plot. Nazu died leaving behind 2 sons namely, Mainuddin and Fazar Ali and their names appeared in SA khatian. Thereafter, Fazar Ali by a registered deed of sale dated 24.12.1960 transferred his share in the suit plot to his brother Mainuddin. Then, Mainuddin transferred the suit land to Moksed Ali whose name has appeared in draft khatian. Said Moksed Ali transferred the suit land to the plaintiffs by two registered deeds dated 12.10.1983 and since then the plaintiffs have been possessing the suit land on payment of rent and taxes and the defendants have got no right, title, interest in the suit land. On 29.09.1995 the defendants threatened to dispossess the plaintiffs from the suit land.
